description: Convert an image to Base64: the data URI, an HTML img tag and CSS, ready to paste. And back again. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

alt.description: Alt text to put in the snippet. Defaults to empty.

data.description: The image as base64 — either the file's bytes base64-encoded, or a whole data URI (data:image/png;base64,…) to inspect. Line breaks, URL-safe characters and missing padding are accepted. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, AVIF, BMP and ICO are recognised from the bytes themselves; about 5 MB of image at most.

name: image_to_base64
title: Image to Base64 Converter
